$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons.

templates.headline: Before you settle your finance early
templates.body: The amount to settle early depends on the date you choose and on the terms of your finance. You can view your settlement amount in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل السداد المبكر لتمويلك
templates.body: يعتمد مبلغ السداد المبكر على التاريخ الذي تختاره وعلى شروط تمويلك. يمكنك الاطلاع على مبلغ السداد في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.

templates.headline: Before you settle your finance early

templates.headline: قبل السداد المبكر لتمويلك

en.cheaper_settlement_date_within_N_days: Each day in the coming weeks was checked, and one date has a lower total cost than settling today.
en.ibra_tier_increases_before_cheapest_date: Your ibra (rebate) rate increases after your next scheduled instalment, under the bank's policy.
en.settlement_fee_applies: Settling early has a fee under the terms of your finance.
en.insurance_refund_due: Part of the cover you paid for is refundable when you settle.
en.takaful_refund_due: Part of your takaful contribution is refundable when you settle.
en.arrears_included_in_settlement: Overdue instalments are included in the settlement amount.
en.salary_linked_benefits_may_change: This finance is linked to your salary transfer.
en.severity_critical: The difference is above the level your bank has set for an important notice.
en.severity_caution: Your bank shows a notice for this situation.

ar.cheaper_settlement_date_within_N_days: تم فحص كل يوم خلال الأسابيع القادمة، ويوجد تاريخ أقل تكلفة من السداد اليوم.
ar.ibra_tier_increases_before_cheapest_date: ترتفع نسبة الإبراء بعد قسطك المجدول القادم وفق سياسة البنك.
ar.settlement_fee_applies: السداد المبكر تترتب عليه رسوم وفق شروط التمويل.
ar.insurance_refund_due: جزء من قيمة الحماية التي دفعتها قابل للاسترداد عند السداد.
ar.takaful_refund_due: جزء من اشتراك التكافل قابل للاسترداد عند السداد.
ar.severity_critical: الفرق أعلى من الحد الذي حدده البنك لإظهار تنبيه مهم.
ar.severity_caution: يُظهر البنك تنبيهاً في هذه الحالة.
